clauses.title: CL-D120 records the per-root correlation, the role schemas, the launch identity and the alarm
clauses.section: ## CL-D120 — Gate result schema version 2 carries an Issue correlation beside the pull-request one
requires: The validator checks each envelope against its root's own closed schema and never walks a union.
the parent supplies both until the Issue driver of step 2 does
the per-file helper alarm resets from 30,000 to 32,000 bytes for every helper file, prompted by `helpers/launch.js`

clauses.title: Version 2 has an Issue correlation, binding and record beside the pull-request ones
requires: const ISSUE_CORR_REQ = words('repository number lifecycle gate invocation contractInput snapshotFingerprint issueSpec');
const ROOT_SCHEMAS = { 1: { pr: SCHEMAS[1], issue: SCHEMAS[1] }, 2: { pr: SCHEMA, issue: ISSUE_SCHEMA } };

clauses.title: An Issue volatile target names no pull-request field and its issue_spec is the correlation's
The read accepts a child that ran with one of the packaged role schemas
The Issue Skill names the packaged composition, its correlation and the packaged launch identity
requires: Every Issue gate launch is composed by packaged `build_gate_launch`
it names no base, head, branch, or draft, and an Issue finding or confirmation binds to its gate by `issueSpec`
The packaged Issue driver derives the Issue `contractInput` and `snapshotFingerprint` (CL-D122).

clauses.title: The gate contract states each root's correlation
requires: Under envelope schema version 2 each root has its own closed correlation (CL-D120).
a finding or confirmation binds to its gate by `issueSpec`, and an Issue record names the candidate identity exactly when the correlation does
Each role's schema covers the roots its gate reviews: the pull-request one, the Issue one, or both (CL-D120).
